CURRENT USER MESSAGE: What is the difference between a device manual and my maintenance log when troubleshooting offline?
ASSISTANT:

memory.scope: Sampled process peaks, not continuous maxima; includes profiling overhead. Fault counters are not physical-read counts.

answers.text:
A device manual provides detailed technical specifications, diagrams, and step-by-step instructions for operating and troubleshooting the device. It includes information on components, safety warnings, and typical issues, often written for end users or technical support.  

A maintenance log records actual service activities, repairs, component replacements, and observations made during maintenance or troubleshooting. It is a record of what was done, when, and by whom, and is used for accountability, compliance, and tracking performance over time.  

When troubleshooting offline, the device manual helps identify potential causes and guide you through diagnostic procedures, while the maintenance log helps you understand the history of the device and any prior issues that may be relevant.
